Control.summary: Base class for all visible controls: layout, relative coordinates, drag/resize and draw event dispatch.

props.classname: Control class name used for InheritsFrom checks and theme/skin lookup; falls back to the class default 'control' when unset.
props.padding: Inner padding {left, top, right, bottom} in pixels; determines clientArea and the client size.
props.borderThickness: Border line width in pixels, default 1.5.
props.borderColor: Primary border color RGBA (usually the bright top/left edge), default {1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.6}.
props.borderColor2: Secondary border color RGBA (usually the dark bottom/right edge), default {0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.8}.
props.focusColor: Highlight/border color RGBA used while the control has focus, default {0.2, 0.2, 1.0, 0.6}.
props.autosize: Whether the control resizes itself to fit its children, default false.
props.savespace: When autosize is on, whether the control shrinks to the minimum needed space; if disabled, autosize normally only grows, default true.
props.resizeGripSize: Size {width, height} of the bottom-right resize grip in pixels, default {11, 11}.
props.dragGripSize: Size {width, height} of the drag grip in pixels, default {10, 10}.
props.dragUseGrip: Whether dragging must grab the drag grip (false means the whole control can be dragged), default false.
props.draggable: Whether the control can be dragged with the mouse, default false.
props.resizable: Whether the control can be resized by dragging its resize grip, default false.
props.tweakDragUseGrip: Whether Tweak (UI edit) mode must use the drag grip, default false.
props.tweakDraggable: Whether the control is draggable in Tweak (UI edit) mode, default false.
props.tweakResizable: Whether the control is resizable in Tweak (UI edit) mode, default false.
props.minWidth: Minimum width in pixels, default 10; SetPos/Resize clamp to this value.
props.minHeight: Minimum height in pixels, default 10; SetPos/Resize clamp to this value.
props.maxWidth: Maximum width in pixels, default 1e9 (effectively unlimited).
props.maxHeight: Maximum height in pixels, default 1e9 (effectively unlimited).
props.fixedRatio: Whether resizing keeps the original width/height ratio, default false.
props.tooltip: Tooltip text (plain text only); Screen walks up the parent chain from the hovered control and takes the first non-empty value.
props.useDList: Whether drawing is cached in an OpenGL display list, default true.
props.safeOpengl: Whether scissor clipping is enabled while drawing the client area so children cannot draw outside it, default true.
props.font: Font config table (font/size/shadow/outline/color, etc.) used by New to create the Font; set to nil when noFont is true.
props.state: Interaction state table {focused, hovered, checked, selected, pressed, enabled}, updated by mouse/focus events.
props.skin: Reference to the skin table, filled in by SkinHandler.LoadSkin during construction.
props.skinName: Skin name; SkinHandler uses it to pick the skin for this control.
props.OnResize: List of resize listeners; UpdateClientArea calls them with (clientWidth, clientHeight) when the size changes.
props.noFont: Whether to skip creating a Font object for this control to save memory, default true.

Control:New.desc: Constructs the control: loads theme defaults and skin, converts padding into client size, creates the font, detects relative constraints, aligns once, then adds the children.

params.obj: Attribute table (rewritten into the control instance)

Control:Dispose.desc: Frees the _own/_children/_all display lists, detaches the font parent, then calls the inherited Dispose (internal).

Control:SetParent.desc: Sets the parent control and then triggers RequestRealign.

params.obj: Parent control (nil detaches it from the parent)

Control:AddChild.desc: Adds a child control and then triggers RequestRealign; skips the relayout when dontUpdate is true.

params.index: Insert position, appended at the end by default

Control:RemoveChild.desc: Removes a child control and triggers RequestRealign when it was found.

Control:Invalidate.desc: Marks _needRedraw and calls RequestUpdate so the display list is rebuilt on the next frame.

Control:_GetMaxChildConstraints.desc: Returns the child area constraints (0, 0, clientWidth, clientHeight) used for relative coordinate math (internal, overridable).

Control:DetectRelativeBounds.desc: Parses position/size constraints, stores _givenBounds/_relativeBounds and sets _isRelative.

Control:GetRelativeBox.desc: Converts the control's relative constraints into an absolute rect using the parent size; when savespace is true, minWidth/minHeight replace the current size.

Control:UpdateClientArea.desc: Recomputes the client size and clientArea from padding; on change it fires OnResize and calls Invalidate.

Control:AlignControl.desc: Takes the GetRelativeBox result and writes it back through _UpdateConstraints.

Control:RequestRealign.desc: Requests a deferred relayout: sets _realignRequested and calls RequestUpdate; requests made during Realign are ignored.

params.savespace: Optional, lay out using minimum space

Control:DisableRealign.desc: Increments the relayout-disable counter (nestable); Realign requests are deferred while disabled.

Control:EnableRealign.desc: Decrements the disable counter; when it reaches zero with a pending request, Realign runs immediately.

Control:Realign.desc: Runs one layout pass: AlignControl, then UpdateLayout, then RealignChildren if the layout did not handle them; converts to RequestRealign while disabled.

params.savespace: Optional, lay out using minimum space

Control:UpdateLayout.desc: When autosize is on, recomputes the own size from the children minimum extents and the relative box, resizes, then realigns the children.
Control:UpdateLayout.returns: Whether autosize applied and the layout was done (nil when not autosizing)

Control:RealignChildren.desc: Calls Realign on every child control, passing savespace.

Control:SetPos.desc: Sets the absolute position and size (any subset of parameters): size is clamped to min/max, clientArea treats w/h as client size and adds padding back, and UpdateClientArea runs on change.

params.dontUpdateRelative: Do not update the stored relative constraints

Control:SetPosRelative.desc: Like SetPos but accepts relative coordinates: relative values are only stored in _relativeBounds and never written to the actual x/y/width/height.

params.dontUpdateRelative: Do not update the stored relative constraints

Control:Resize.desc: Changes only the size; equivalent to SetPosRelative(nil, nil, w, h, clientArea, dontUpdateRelative).

Control:_UpdateConstraints.desc: Writes the constraints back through SetPos without touching the relative constraint records (internal).

Control:GetMinimumExtents.desc: Returns the minimum width/height the control needs: with autosize it uses the children minimum extents, clamped to min/max.

Control:GetChildrenMinimumExtents.desc: Takes the maximum GetMinimumExtents over all children and adds this control's padding.

Control:GetCurrentExtents.desc: Returns the current bounding box including the children.

Control:GetChildrenCurrentExtents.desc: Merges each child's GetCurrentExtents into a bounding box.

Control:StartResizing.desc: Stores the initial mouse position, size and position in self.resizing so MouseMove can compute deltas.

Control:StopResizing.desc: Clears self.resizing and leaves resize mode.

Control:StartDragging.desc: Sets self.dragging to true and starts dragging.

Control:LocalToClient.desc: Converts local coordinates to client coordinates (subtracts the clientArea padding offset).

Control:ClientToLocal.desc: Converts client coordinates to local coordinates (adds the clientArea padding offset).

Control:ParentToClient.desc: Converts parent coordinates to client coordinates (subtracts its own x/y and padding).

Control:ClientToParent.desc: Converts client coordinates to parent coordinates (adds its own x/y and padding).

Control:InClientArea.desc: Whether a local coordinate falls inside the client area rect (edges inclusive).

Control:Update.desc: Task handler callback: runs the pending Realign, and rebuilds the display list when a redraw is needed and the control is in view.

Control:InstantUpdate.desc: Immediate update: when in view, rebuilds through Update if a redraw is needed, otherwise rebuilds _all_dlist directly.

Control:_UpdateOwnDList.desc: Recursively updates the children first, then rebuilds the _own_dlist holding only this control's own drawing (internal).

Control:_UpdateChildrenDList.desc: Old implementation, commented out in the source; it used to build a _children_dlist holding only the children (internal).

Control:_UpdateAllDList.desc: Rebuilds the _all_dlist holding this control and all children, requesting an instant update from the parent when needed (internal).

Control:_DrawInClientArea.desc: Moves into client-area coordinates and runs fnc; with safeOpengl it clips via PushScissor/PopScissor (internal).

Control:IsInView.desc: Whether this control's rect lies inside the parent's view (false when there is no parent).

Control:IsChildInView.desc: Whether the given child's rect lies inside this control's view.

Control:IsRectInView.desc: Recursively checks whether the given rect intersects this control's client area and the ancestor viewports.

Control:_DrawChildrenInClientArea.desc: Draws the visible children inside the client area in back-to-front order (internal).

Control:DrawBackground.desc: Draws the background; empty here, overridden by the skin/theme.

Control:DrawDragGrip.desc: Draws the drag grip; empty here, overridden by the skin/theme.

Control:DrawResizeGrip.desc: Draws the resize grip; empty here, overridden by the skin/theme.

Control:DrawBorder.desc: Draws the border; empty here, overridden by the skin/theme.

Control:DrawGrips.desc: Decides from resizable and draggable plus dragUseGrip whether to draw the resize/drag grips.

Control:DrawControl.desc: Draws the control itself: snaps the position to a half-integer grid when snapToGrid is set, then calls DrawBackground and DrawBorder.

Control:DrawForList.desc: Display-list variant of drawing: calls the own dlist or draws the body, then the children, the post-children hook and the grips.

Control:Draw.desc: Normal draw entry: uses _all_dlist when available, otherwise draws the body, the children, DrawControlPostChildren and the grips.

Control:TweakDraw.desc: Draws in Tweak (UI edit) mode by forwarding the TweakDraw event to the children.

Control:DrawChildren.desc: Draws the children inside the client area with the Draw event when any exist.

Control:DrawChildrenForList.desc: Draws the children inside the client area with the DrawForList event and registers them for redraw when any exist.

Control:HitTest.desc: Hit test: recurses into the children first, then tries NCHitTest, then returns itself or false according to noClickThrough.

Control:MouseDown.desc: Runs NCMouseDown, then hands the event to the children inside the client area, then falls back to NCMouseDownPostChildren.

Control:MouseMove.desc: Mouse move: while dragging, moves by dx/dy; while resizing, changes the size by the delta (fixedRatio keeps the ratio); otherwise forwards to the children.

Control:MouseUp.desc: Mouse up: clears the resizing/dragging state, converts the coordinates to the client area, then forwards to the children.

Control:MouseClick.desc: Mouse click: converts the coordinates to the client area and forwards to the children.

Control:MouseDblClick.desc: Double click: converts the coordinates to the client area and forwards to the children.

Control:MouseWheel.desc: Mouse wheel: converts the coordinates to the client area and forwards to the children.

Control:FocusUpdate.desc: Forwards the focus update event to the inherited implementation (internal).

Control:MouseOver.desc: Raises MouseOver: forwards it, then sets state.hovered = true and calls Invalidate to redraw.

Control:MouseOut.desc: Raises MouseOut: forwards it, then sets state.hovered = false and calls Invalidate to redraw.

fileDesc: Defines Control, the base class for all visible controls (an Object subclass): padding and client area, relative coordinate constraints, autosize layout, drag and resize, cached display-list drawing, hit testing and mouse event dispatch.
